save_numpy_tensors_to_bytes: save a dictionary of numpy tensors to raw bytes in safetensors format
save_numpy_tensors_to_file: save a dictionary of numpy tensors to a safetensors file on disk
load_numpy_tensors_from_bytes: load numpy tensors from raw bytes in safetensors format
load_numpy_tensors_from_file: load numpy tensors from a safetensors file on disk
flatten_numpy_tensors_for_serialization: flatten a dictionary of numpy arrays into TensorSpecs for safetensors serialization
